reserveReview.rationale: 2026-11-22 pinned renewal. PicWe docs still claim Phase 1 100% USDC 1:1 backing without publishing an itemized reserve inventory or attestation. Pinned reads across all five tracked chains confirm two divergent accounting regimes that remain unreconciled. Across the V2 omni-chain deployments (BSC block 135105062, hash 0xd17dd951447a985c059fe779e9059378fe6e9f69913f773c8fac7b10381c822d, 2026-11-22T15:43:09Z, matching block 134557903; Base block 60855375; Arbitrum block 526552416; Plume block 107474119; Movement current package 0xf39c...1ff6 at ledger_version 240654443, block 107395950, hash 0x495963f7306363697927dd9b8254774180547b18162a9142ecd4d5dd04d99ece, 2026-11-22T15:43:09Z), issued V2 WEUSD totals 26,136.814303 (BSC 21,426.157806, Base 1,447.438032, Arbitrum 2,409.501399, Plume 12.200567, Movement current 841.516499; plus 5.097300 on HashKey Chain outside the tracked contract list) against 26,549.144040 USDC held in the five mint/redeem escrows (BSC 0.624899 USDC plus 9.99 USDT against a 21,425.533417 crossChainDeficit; Base 7,101.842108; Arbitrum 1,941.499061; Plume 1.139986; Movement current resource account 0x16bb...e3ab 17,504.037986 USDC covering 841.516499 stablecoin_reserves plus 16,662.521487 cross_chain_reserves). However, the dominant supply remains on the legacy Movement package 0xed80...f83d (ConcurrentSupply 465,086.702603 WEUSD, 94.68% of combined tracked supply and DefiLlama's Movement supply source). At ledger_version 240654443, legacy weusd_operations::MintState records stablecoin_reserves 58232342 (58.232342 USDT, matching resource account 0x4261...0e39 balance) and move_reserves 1343060443 with move_ratio 1000; CoinInfo<0x1::aptos_coin::AptosCoin> verifies MOVE has 8 decimals on Movement, so move_reserves equals 13.43060443 MOVE (matching 0x4261...0e39 AptosCoin balance, worth ~$0.06 at CoinGecko MOVE $0.00459, correcting the prior 100x decimal misread of 1,343.06 MOVE). Legacy get_total_reserves() still returns unbacked counters (550,700 MOVE and 458,021 USDT) not present in the resource account, and WEUSD trades near $0.665 on CoinGecko. Because no published reconciliation accounts for the 465,086.702603 legacy Movement liability or links it legally to V2 USDC escrows, composition remains one explicit 100% unreconciled residual at conservative very-high risk and probable confidence.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Actual whole-book reserve mix, weights, and locations remain undisclosed: the dominant Movement legacy WEUSD supply (465,086.702603 WEUSD, 94.68% of combined tracked supply) holds only 58.232342 USDT and 13.43060443 MOVE on-chain while V2 mint escrows hold 26,549.144040 USDC against 26,136.814303 V2 WEUSD, and no attestation reconciles legacy liabilities, V2 escrows, and issuer docs.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 2026-07-30: PicWe still names no bank, trust, or qualified custodian for WEUSD reserves. Documented custody is issuer-operated smart-contract mint/redeem infrastructure (EVM CREATE2 mint 0x5D54…F22C; Movement current package 0xf39c…1ff6 and legacy package 0xed80…f83d holding MintState reserve counters). Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation/anti-rehypothecation terms, successor-custody mechanics, and failure-domain isolation from PicWe admin EOAs / package upgrade keys are unpublished. Security docs mention multi-sig and timelocks generically without identifying reserve custody controllers.
